name: Records of Fantasy: Caring for my new cat...Femboy?
source:
He traded his dreams for freedom when he was too young to understand the cost. Now, years later, a boy with a mysterious past needs someone to help him remember what he lost… and you might be the only one patient enough to earn his trust, and his heart.

A slow-burn, choice-driven Dating  Sim set in the misty mountain town of Ashfel. Build a genuine bond. Watch Hanta’s walls come down. Discover what it means to dream again -  together.

Itch.io Page: https://atomicgarlic.itch.io/caring-cat-femboy
translation:
当年年少懵懂、尚不明白代价几何的他，用自己的梦想换取了自由。多年后的今天，这名身世成谜的少年急需有人帮他找回昔日失落的一切……而唯有足够耐心的你，或许才能赢得他的信任与芳心。

这是一部设定在云雾缭绕的山间小镇阿什费尔的慢热抉择向恋爱模拟游戏。建立真挚的羁绊，见证汉塔一步步卸下心防，与他携手重新领悟追梦的意义吧。

itch.io页面：https://atomicgarlic.itch.io/caring-cat-femboy
